Class GameController

java.lang.Object
com.comp2042.GameController
public class GameController extends Object
Connects keyboard/buttons and the animation clock to a testable game session.

    • stepStart

      static long stepStart(long previous, long now, long interval)
      Preserves a fractional step remainder, discarding long stalls to avoid teleportation.
      Parameters:
      previous - previous step start timestamp, or zero before startup
      now - current timestamp in nanoseconds
      interval - positive movement interval in nanoseconds
      Returns:
      start timestamp for the next rendered movement interval
